misprints.note: The first article is printed without its circumflex; the next τῆς τιμῆς on the same line has it.
The abbreviation 'l' is printed without its full stop.

misprints.probably_meant: ἀποπλανᾶσθαί τινος (enclitic accent, correct as printed)
misprints.note: This is not a printer's error. The acute on -αί comes from the enclitic τινος that follows. Kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The ring on å is broken in the print and looks like 'fä'. I read it as 'få'.
The punctuation at the right margin after σταθμᾶσθαι is faint. It looks more like a comma than a stop.
There is a stray vertical mark (a lead or broken type) between 'ἀπό-,' and 'ἔκπλους'. I left it out.
After 'blad' there is a mark like an apostrophe, probably dust or displaced type. I left it out.
There is a stray tilde-like mark between 'τι.' and 'ἀποσπεύδειν'. I treated it as dust and read the punctuation as a full stop only.
